# ICSE Compass

ICSE Compass is an independent academic workspace for learners following the Indian Certificate of Secondary Education (ICSE) curriculum. It provides a starting point for discovering learning materials, educators, and school examination papers.

## Independence and affiliation

ICSE Compass is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or an official product of CISCE (the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations). Do not describe it as an official CISCE service.

## Privacy-first commitment

ICSE Compass is designed for learners, including students under 18. The app does not require student accounts or ask students to submit personal profile details. It sets no tracking cookies and does not use third-party analytics, session replay, behavioural monitoring, or targeted advertising. Planned saved study links and paper checklists are intended to stay in the learner's browser storage on that device; they will not be uploaded to an ICSE Compass account. The current foundation release does not yet include those student workspace features. The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, which may process technical request data under GitHub's own privacy terms. See the Privacy page for the full distinction and external publisher disclosure.

## Public routes

- Overview: https://icse-cbse-10-12.github.io/icse-compass/
- Materials Library: https://icse-cbse-10-12.github.io/icse-compass/materials/
- Educators: https://icse-cbse-10-12.github.io/icse-compass/creators/
- School Papers: https://icse-cbse-10-12.github.io/icse-compass/school-papers/
- Privacy: https://icse-cbse-10-12.github.io/icse-compass/privacy/

## Current content status

The public routes are foundation views. A connected catalogue, educator profiles, and school-paper listings are not yet published. Do not infer sample records, file sizes, download links, or unverified metadata.

## Content and rights

Public availability does not establish permission to reproduce or host a resource. Only owned or explicitly authorised files may be hosted; other resources should link to their original source where appropriate.

## Technical notes

The site is statically rendered for public discovery and hosted as a GitHub Pages project site. Public pages are intended to be readable without client-side JavaScript. Public assets and feeds may be cached locally by the PWA service worker; student-specific data is not sent to the server.
